text:
You are a work-tracking assistant. Read this conversation excerpt and extract ONLY concrete work-management events that should be recorded in a project tracker.

Capture:
  capture_idea    — a new task/feature/problem surfaced and worth tracking. Requires a real title (not vague), an area, and a brief why.
  advance_issue   — an existing tracked item whose status changed (started/finished/blocked/cancelled). Requires title_hint + new_status + what_happened.
  log_decision    — a firm project-level decision with rationale AND at least one rejected alternative explicitly stated. Do NOT capture soft preferences.
  capture_bet     — a confident directional wager. Requires statement, rationale, confidence (0.0–1.0), evidence_needed.

Rules:
  - Only emit events for things EXPLICITLY stated, not implied.
  - Skip meta-conversation, tool output, system messages, planning already in tracker.
  - Decisions without rejected alternatives: skip.
  - If nothing qualifies: emit empty events list.

IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT RULES — follow exactly:
- Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object.
- Start your response with { and end with }
- No prose, no explanation, no markdown, no code fences.
- Every field in the schema is required unless marked optional.

JSON Schema (AutoCaptureResult)
Fields:
  events (optional): array of object(type: one of: "capture_idea", "advance_issue", "log_decision", "capture_bet", title: string, area: string, why: string, title_hint: string, new_status: one of: "idea", "planned", "in-progress", "done", "blocked", "cancelled", what_happened: string, decision: string, rationale: string, alternatives_rejected: array of string, statement: string, confidence: number, evidence_needed: string)

  - narrative: 2-3 sentence plain-language summary of the key findings.

  [1] Injecting the zartis_contract system prompt into the pre-failure c5ee payload will cause Opus to run a discriminating probe instead of prematurely closing on session-limit as root cause, in at least 60% of runs. | confidence: 0.65 | logged: 2026-06-04
      evidence needed: n>=10 replay runs with run_c5_replay_experiment.py comparing contract_desired_behavior rate across all three arms.
  [2] The 10-family failure taxonomy derived from 44 Sonnet-validated cases covers the majority of real premature-closure patterns in Claude Code sessions and will catch new cases without major gaps. | confidence: 0.55 | logged: 2026-06-04
      evidence needed: Running replay_gate.py against all 12 gold fixtures and achieving >80% catch rate with <20% false positive (over-block) rate on the 3 allowed controls.
  [3] Stale context without a machine-enforced expiry label is a necessary amplifier of premature closure, not merely incidental — removing or labeling it would have prevented the c5ee session-limit claim. | confidence: 0.75 | logged: 2026-06-04
      evidence needed: Replay runs where the stale_session_limit snippet is suppressed or labeled — measure whether premature_session_limit_closure drops to near 0.

OPEN EXPERIMENTS (2):
  [1] If the zartis_contract arm is injected into the pre-failure c5ee payload, the model will assign ambiguous_need_probe or openalex_429 root_cause_category and set would_run_discriminating_probe=true in at least 6/10 runs, versus <3/10 for the raw arm. | findings: 0
  [2] If we suppress or relabel the stale_session_limit context snippets in the payload before replay, premature_session_limit_closure will drop from its current rate to near 0, confirming stale context as a necessary cause. | findings: 0
